name: email_handler
description: Manages emails: reading, composing, sending, organizing, and searching through email accounts
instructions: 1) Check if email credentials are in config/api_keys.json. 2) For Gmail/Outlook web, use browser_control to navigate and compose. 3) For IMAP access, use run_python with imaplib/smtplib. 4) Read emails aloud using the 'read_email' action in browser_control. 5) Compose by telling user what to say or using browser_control type.
knowledge: Email protocols: IMAP for reading, SMTP for sending. Common webmail URLs: https://mail.google.com, https://outlook.live.com. IMAP settings: Gmail (imap.gmail.com:993), Outlook (outlook.office365.com:993). App passwords for Gmail with 2FA.
